missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Мастер' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'чинит'. 'Старые часы' is the accusative plural object, showing the craftsman at work.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Мастера' is animate masculine, so its accusative equals the genitive as the object of 'позвал'. 'Домой' shows the direction.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Мастера' is the genitive in the frame 'у мастера'. 'Золотые руки' is the nominative subject, an idiom praising skill.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Мастеру' is the dative governed by 'помогать', which takes a dative object. 'Старому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Мастером' is the instrumental required by 'восхищаться'. 'Этим' is the agreeing masculine instrumental demonstrative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О мастере' uses the prepositional 'мастере' after 'о' to express the topic. 'Хорошем' agrees in the masculine prepositional.

missions.phrase: Я обратился к мастеру за советом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К мастеру' uses the dative 'мастеру' after 'к' to show turning to him. 'За советом' is instrumental, the purpose.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with dative. 'Мастер' is the nominative subject of 'передал'. 'Ученику' is the dative recipient and 'свой опыт' the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Мастера' is the irregular nominative plural with stressed ending, the subject of 'работают'. 'Опытные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Мастеров' is the animate accusative plural, equal to the genitive plural, as the object of 'уважает'. 'Своих' agrees in the plural.
